analysis_status: Post-review descriptive analysis, not new blind confirmation; local references use past KAGC labels, not pure zero-shot.
calibration_weighting: Pooled reliability bins; source-group-equal errors in freshness and local comparisons.
limitations: Age strata can differ in traffic and event prevalence; observational differences do not identify a causal freshness effect. Local first-group warmup is omitted from every compared method.
